EIGV-M1.description: Eigenvalue Analysis Control (EIGV-M1). ANAL_TYPE selects the method (LANCZOS vs RITZ) and drives which fields apply: LANCZOS uses FREQ_NO/FREQ_RANGE/STURM_SEQ, RITZ uses GLINK_VECTOR/RITZ_LOAD. Only a single record exists (key must be 1).

ANAL_TYPE.description: Analysis (eigenvalue) method. Case-insensitive. LANCZOS = Eigen Vectors (Lanczos/Subspace Iteration); RITZ = Ritz Vectors. Determines which of the other fields are used.

FREQ_NO.description: [ANAL_TYPE=LANCZOS] Number of frequencies (modes) to extract. Required for LANCZOS; not used for RITZ.

FREQ_RANGE.description: [ANAL_TYPE=LANCZOS] Frequency range of interest. Required for LANCZOS; not used for RITZ.

OPT_USE.description: Whether a frequency range of interest is applied. When true, FREQ_MIN and FREQ_MAX are required.

FREQ_MIN.description: Search From [cps]. Required when OPT_USE is true; otherwise not used.

FREQ_MAX.description: Search To [cps]. Required when OPT_USE is true; otherwise not used.

STURM_SEQ.description: [ANAL_TYPE=LANCZOS] Perform Sturm sequence check. Optional; defaults to false. Not used for RITZ.

GLINK_VECTOR.description: [ANAL_TYPE=RITZ] Include GL-link (ground-link) force vectors. Required for RITZ; not used for LANCZOS.

OPT_USE.description: Whether GL-link force vectors are included. When true, GLINK_NUMBER is required.

GLINK_NUMBER.description: Number of generations for the GL-link force vectors. Required when OPT_USE is true; otherwise not used.

RITZ_LOAD.description: [ANAL_TYPE=RITZ] Ritz starting load vectors. Required for RITZ; must contain at least one item (max D_EIGV_NUMLC, excess is ignored). Not used for LANCZOS.

TYPE.description: Starting load vector type. Case-insensitive. LOAD = static load case; GROUND = ground acceleration direction.

LOAD_NAME.description: When TYPE=LOAD: name of an existing static load case. When TYPE=GROUND: one of ACCX, ACCY, ACCZ (ground acceleration direction); other values are rejected.

NUM_OF_GEN.description: Number of generations (Ritz vectors) produced from this starting load vector.
